stem: Which set of ages matches the NSW Blue Book developmental surveillance schedule?

options.text: 6 months, 12 months, 18 months, 2 years, 3 years, 4 years

explanation: NSW Blue Book developmental surveillance is scheduled at 6 months, 12 months, 18 months, 2 years, 3 years, and 4 years.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Developmental Delay / Developmental Surveillance

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because these ages do not match the Blue Book schedule and omit several listed surveillance points.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because these ages are not the standard NSW Blue Book surveillance ages.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because the NSW Blue Book schedule includes developmental surveillance at 6 months, 12 months, 18 months, 2 years, 3 years, and 4 years.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because the schedule includes six surveillance points, not only three age points.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because the Blue Book surveillance schedule does not use this set of ages.
